headline: Frontlines Flare as Bases Shift Across Theater
war_summary: Since the 04:44 edition the war has entered a new surge of ownership changes. Linn Mercy has become the most volatile sector, recording twenty‑nine captures in the last day and seventeen in the past two hours, pushing both factions’ casualty rates above 2,500 per hour. Fishermans Row remains sharply contested with eighteen flips yesterday and a fresh burst of seven events in the last two hours, driving Colonial and Warden losses to roughly 30 and 20 per hour respectively. Endless Shore, while still the second‑busiest region with nineteen daily captures, shows a marked cooling trend, its hourly casualties dropping from the 4,500–5,200 range to single digits. Dead Lands retains high intensity, logging seven captures in twenty‑four hours and accelerating casualty rates near 1,100 (Colonial) and 1,600 (Warden) per hour. Kings Cage added three captures in the last two hours and seven overall, with both sides’ losses climbing past 1,300 per hour. New activity appeared at Stlican Shelf and Tempest Island, each registering captures at the current filing time, indicating fresh pressure on their strategic bases. Meanwhile the majority of rear‑area hexes report no ownership changes and flat casualty trends.
